title: Cantilever, end load
description: Steel bar 200 x 20 x 20 mm, end x = 0 fixed, 1000 N down (-z) spread over the free end x = 200.

quantities.label: Tip deflection (centre of the free end, -z)
quantities.citation: W. C. Young, R. G. Budynas, A. M. Sadegh, Roark's Formulas for Stress and Strain, 8th ed., McGraw-Hill 2012, Table 8.1 case 1a (cantilever, end load)
quantities.tolerance_reason: Euler-Bernoulli theory leaves out shear deformation, which adds F L / (k G A), about 0.8 % at L/h = 10; the rest covers the discretisation error of a 4 mm mesh.

quantities.label: Bending stress at mid-length, top face
quantities.formula: M c / I with M = F (L - x) and c = h/2, at the x of the probe's node
quantities.citation: J. M. Gere, B. J. Goodno, Mechanics of Materials, 8th ed., Cengage 2013, Chapter 5, normal stresses in beams (flexure formula)
quantities.tolerance_reason: Nodal stresses are extrapolated from the integration points, about 1 % off at this mesh; on the free top face the other stresses are zero, so von Mises equals the bending stress.
